name: WhereAreThePeople(WATP)
teaser: A compact AI proximity tracker showing the nearest contacts by faction.
description_html:
Where Are The People

Where Are The People is a compact in-raid proximity tracker for SPT. It displays the distance to the nearest AI contact in each faction, together with the total number currently detected.

Video Preview

Features

  • Displays the nearest PMC and total PMC count
  • Displays the nearest Scav and total Scav count
  • Raider detection
  • Rogue detection
  • Boss detection with the nearest boss name and distance
  • Guard detection
  • Cultist detection
  • Special categories are hidden when no matching AI is present
  • Automatically switches to the next closest contact when the current one dies
  • Configurable position anywhere on the screen
  • Configurable scale and panel opacity
  • Configurable refresh interval
  • Configurable maximum tracking distance
  • Cached AI tracking designed to reduce stuttering
  • Automatically hides while the pause menu, inventory or loot interface is open
  • F9 key to hide or show the tracker

Display Example

385m PMC      1
 11m SCAV    15
 74m RAIDER   3
BOSS          1
208m Kollontay
202m GUARD    4

Only the nearest contact is displayed for each faction. The number on the right represents the total number of detected contacts in that category.

Bosses are displayed on two lines: the first line shows the total boss count, and the second line shows the nearest boss and its distance.

Boss, Guard, Cultist, Raider and Rogue categories only appear when at least one matching AI is detected.

Configuration

With BepInEx Configuration Manager installed, open the configuration menu in game to adjust:

  • Horizontal position
  • Vertical position
  • HUD scale
  • Panel opacity
  • Refresh interval
  • Maximum tracking distance
  • Menu hiding behavior
  • Toggle key

Changes can be previewed directly while the configuration menu is open.

Installation

  1. Download the mod archive.
  2. Extract the BepInEx folder directly into the root of your SPT installation.
  3. Launch SPT.
  4. Enter a raid.

The plugin will be installed to:

BepInEx/plugins/Nayco-WhereAreThePeople/WhereAreThePeople.dll

Uninstallation

Delete the following folder:

BepInEx/plugins/Nayco-WhereAreThePeople

You may also delete the configuration file:

BepInEx/config/com.nayco.wherearethepeople.cfg

Compatibility

  • SPT 4.1.0
  • Client-side BepInEx plugin
  • Fika compatibility has not been tested
  • No profile or server database modifications
  • No network connections or telemetry

Important Warning

This mod provides information similar to an AI proximity or ESP-style tracker. It is intended exclusively for Single Player Tarkov.
